title: Stop airflowctl updates from resetting omitted bool fields
body:
Generated boolean flags in airflowctl default to `False` unless the datamodel is on an allowlist. For optional fields that means an omitted flag overwrites the stored value:

- `airflowctl dags update <dag_id>` without `--is-paused` / `--no-is-paused` sends `{"is_paused": false, "scheduling_state": null}` and silently unpauses a paused Dag. It also makes `--scheduling-state <state>` unusable, because `is_paused: false` is always sent with it and the server requires exactly one of the two.
- `airflowctl pools update --pool p --slots 10` sends `include_deferred: false` and turns it off on a pool that had it on.
- Other optional bool fields (for example `backfill create --run-on-latest-version`) are forced to `False` instead of being left to the server.

This PR:

- Uses each field's own default for every generated bool flag and drops the `field_bool_default_datamodels` allowlist. Fields that default to `True`/`False` keep that default (`tasks clear` still dry-runs by default); optional fields stay `None` and are left out of the request.
- Leaves `None` fields out of the `dags update` request body (the other update/create operations already did this). This also stops sending `"scheduling_state": null`, which older servers such as 3.3.2 reject as an extra field.
- Makes `dags update` fail on the client with "Provide exactly one of --is-paused / --no-is-paused or --scheduling-state." when it gets neither or both, instead of sending the request and showing the server's validation error.

User-visible change: a bare `airflowctl dags update <dag_id>` used to unpause the Dag and now exits with the message above. `pools update` without `--include-deferred` / `--no-include-deferred` no longer sends the field, so the server rejects the request (it requires the field on a PATCH without `update_mask`) instead of turning the setting off.

### Reproduction (before)

Against a local api-server built from `main` (SQLite, simple auth manager), with one Dag that starts paused. `>>>` shows the PATCH body airflowctl sent.

```
airflowctl at main (3e302fd257)
$ airflowctl dags pause repro_dag
    -> Dag state: is_paused=True scheduling_state=paused
$ airflowctl dags update repro_dag
>>> PATCH /api/v2/dags/repro_dag? body={"is_paused":false,"scheduling_state":null}
<<< 200 
    -> Dag state: is_paused=False scheduling_state=active
$ airflowctl dags update repro_dag --scheduling-state paused
>>> PATCH /api/v2/dags/repro_dag? body={"is_paused":false,"scheduling_state":"paused"}
<<< 422 Value error, Exactly one of `is_paused` or `scheduling_state` must be provided
    -> Dag state: is_paused=True scheduling_state=paused
```

The behaviour after this PR is covered by the unit tests below; I did not re-run the server reproduction for the latest revision.

### Tests

- `uv run --project airflow-ctl pytest airflow-ctl/tests -q`: 448 passed. The new cases for a bare/conflicting `dags update`, an omitted `pools update --include-deferred`, and the `dags update` request body fail without the change; the explicit-flag cases pin that `--is-paused` / `--no-is-paused` and `--include-deferred` / `--no-include-deferred` still send `True` / `False`.
- `prek run mypy-airflow-ctl --all-files`: passed.
- `airflowctl <command> --help` output for `dags update`, `dags trigger`, `pools create`, `pools update`, `backfill create` and `tasks clear` is identical with and without the change, so the help images are unaffected. `generate-airflowctl-help-images` was skipped locally because it needs breeze.

No newsfragment, because airflow-ctl doesn't use them. `airflow-ctl/RELEASE_NOTES.rst` is not edited here because its header says it is populated at release time and must not be edited in PRs.

-    def _get_bool_arg_default(self, parameter_type: str, field_default: Any) -> bool | None:
-        """Get default for a generated bool flag: the datamodel field default for datamodels in ``field_bool_default_datamodels``, otherwise False."""
-        if parameter_type in self.field_bool_default_datamodels and (
-            field_default is None or isinstance(field_default, bool)
-        ):
+    @staticmethod
+    def _get_bool_arg_default(field_default: Any) -> bool | None:
+        """
+        Get the default for a generated bool flag from its datamodel field default.
+
+        An omitted flag must keep the API semantics: a bare ``tasks clear`` keeps ``dry_run=True``,
+        and an optional field such as ``is_paused`` or ``include_deferred`` stays ``None`` so it is
+        not sent at all instead of overwriting the stored value with ``False``.
+        """
+        if field_default is None or isinstance(field_default, bool):
             return field_default
         return False
